summary: Regression + new-feature testing after Offices frontend restructure (Card layout, global Density toggle, no-wrap table, red destructive Delete). Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass (18 existing + 1 new test verifying optional-field clearing via null payload). Frontend: full E2E via Playwright — login, offices page inside Card with CardHeader title+Add button (no big PageHeader), create with '(Optional)' placeholders and no placeholder on Code/Name, edit prefill, telephone clear via null persisted correctly on reopen, row-actions Delete has text-destructive class + red AlertDialog confirm (bg-destructive computed rgb(239,68,68)), density toggle switches dense(28px)→comfortable(36px) on the Add button, data-density on <html> and localStorage 'ui-density' both set, persists across page reload, table has [&_td]:whitespace-nowrap and computed white-space:nowrap, wrapper has overflow-x:auto, bulk delete with checkbox multi-select + red confirm deletes multiple rows.
critical_code_review_comments: OfficesPage.jsx is 788 lines — still monolithic. Consider splitting OfficeFormDialog, column defs, and delete/bulk-delete AlertDialogs into their own files for maintainability.

buildPayload sends null for latitude/longitude when an empty numeric field is cleared on edit — good. Radius, however, resets to hard-coded 100 when cleared on edit (line 160). If the user later customises the seed default this constant will drift; consider importing from a shared constant.
server.py update_office uses $set with local doc.update(updates) merge — works, but find_one_and_update(return_document=AFTER) would be more robust (avoids drift if concurrent writers).

Startup indexes (offices.code / offices.name unique) are now created — good. Note the DB-level unique index will raise a DuplicateKeyError (500 by default) if the app-level _assert_unique is bypassed; consider a try/except in create_office/update_office to convert to 409.
Login button label is 'Sign In' (not 'Login' as some prior docs suggested) — not a bug, just noting for future test writers.
test_credentials: user@example.com / password (mock, frontend-only) — Sign In button (not 'Login').
seed_data_creation: None persisted beyond test — all TEST_* and BulkTest rows cleaned up via bulk-delete. The 7 seeded offices (SKM, SBG, PSK, PMK, PGD, KJT, CGK) that appeared on the page are unrelated to my tests and remain intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Offices CMS fully solid end-to-end. Density toggle applies globally via data-density on <html> + CSS vars in index.css. Control height changes measured on Add button: dense=28px, comfortable=36px. localStorage key is 'ui-density'. Login button label is 'Sign In'. New backend test test_update_clear_optional_field_with_null validates the critical null-clear contract for optional fields. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_offices.py.
